messages:
maya: Quick checkpoint — we need a single dependency map for the Q4 release bundle (model-partitioning, private-deploy telemetry, dedicated autoscale). Goal: identify the critical path and owners by EOD Thursday. Proposed high-level milestones: spec freeze 2026-10-10, infra integration 2026-10-24, canary 2026-11-07, GA 2026-11-21.

leo: I can take model-partitioning runtime. Deliverables: kernel selection notes, partitioning API, perf matrix. Will need quant team help for accuracy regression tests.

sasha: Infra will own capacity & autoscale. Note: we need a firm quote for reserved GPUs for 2026-11-01 or autoscale fallback won't be ready. I'll file a quota request today.

nina: I'll own canary policy and runbooks. Suggest gating rules: infra healthy, perf delta within guards, and customer-facing evals green. If any fail -> immediate rollback + incident channel page.

ton y: UX will ship rollout controls and telemetry panels. Need API contract for feature flags + telemetry hooks by 2026-09-30 to start mockups.

rachel: I'll manage telemetry schema and sample payloads. Heads-up: privacy may block some fields; will coordinate with Legal.

martin: Eval team will provide snapshot diffs and golden tests. Dependency: access to labeled sample set or we do a smaller human-labeling pass.

legal-bot: New ticket PRIV-601 created for telemetry fields review. ETA initial response 4 business days.

leo: Dependencies from my side: (1) quant team signoff on model accuracy, (2) eng-platform to expose partition metadata (owner: rachel), (3) infra quota (owner: sasha). Any slip in infra quota or legal blocks quant/partition perf validation.

sasha: Blocker: reserved GPU pricing approval from finance for extra capacity. I'll escalate if not approved by 2026-10-05. Also need routing policy for EU/US when capacity constrained.

nina: For canary ramp plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% over 48h windows, with automatic halt if regression > thresholds. Will author automation and test harness.

ton y: UX note — add a visible timestamped audit trail for rollouts + a one-click rollback reason field. That helps CS and SRE during incidents.

rachel: If Legal strips payloads, we may lose signal for golden tests. Mitigation: add hashed context keys and a small human-labeled subset. Martin, can eval accept hashed tokens?

martin: Yes, hashed tokens are fine as long as we can link examples to labels. We'll define a small annotation spec.

maya: Critical path summary (today): 1) finance approval for reserved GPUs, 2) legal telemetry signoff, 3) API contract for telemetry/flags. If any of these slip past the spec freeze date, GA likely shifts. Mark as red if ETA > milestone.

leo: I'll publish a dependency matrix + rough Gantt by 2026-09-25 and flag top 5 risks.

sasha: Quota request submitted: INFRA-889. Pinged finance. Routing policy doc in progress.

nina: Canary automation PR will be ready for review 2026-10-01.

ton y: API contract draft by 2026-09-30, will post link.

rachel: Telemetry schema draft by 2026-09-28.

maya: Action items recap:
- leo: dependency matrix + Gantt (2026-09-25)
- rachel: telemetry schema + sample payloads (2026-09-28)
- tony: API contract for flags & hooks (2026-09-30)
- nina: canary automation + runbooks (2026-10-01)
- sasha: quota + routing decision (2026-10-05)
- martin: eval annotation spec (2026-10-02)
- maya: consolidate map and escalate blockers to PM leads (ongoing)

deploy-bot: note: staging-feature-flag scheduled 2026-11-07 03:00 UTC for canary start. :robot_face:

cs-team: We can run a pilot with two customers post-canary. Need a 1-pager and contact list by 2026-10-15.

maya: Let's have a 30m triage Thu 08:30 PT to lock owners & surface any hard blockers. Update the dependency matrix as you land items; cancel if everything green. Thanks all.
